description: This file provides utility functions for managing environment variable mappings between common and framework-specific formats using YAML templates. It includes functions to retrieve template paths, parse YAML configs, apply prefixes, and map environment variables both ways, primarily supporting framework-specific environment configuration management.

methods.name: Path get_template_path(framework: str)
methods.description: Constructs the path to an environment template file for a given framework, raising an error if not found.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Dict[str,str]] parse_template_file(template_path: Path)
methods.description: Reads and parses a YAML template file to extract optional prefix and a mapping dictionary.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] apply_prefix_mapping(common_env: Dict[str, str], prefix: str)
methods.description: Applies a prefix to all environment variable names in a dictionary.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] map_common_to_framework(framework: str, common_env: Dict[str, str])
methods.description: Maps a set of common environment variables to framework-specific ones using a template.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] map_framework_to_common(framework: str, framework_env: Dict[str, str])
methods.description: Reverses the mapping, converting framework-specific environment variables back to common variables.

methods.name: list get_supported_frameworks()
methods.description: Lists available frameworks based on existing template directories.

ctags.name: apply_prefix_mapping
ctags.pattern: /^def apply_prefix_mapping(common_env: Dict[str, str], prefix: str) -> Dict[str, str]:$/

ctags.name: map_common_to_framework
ctags.pattern: /^def map_common_to_framework(framework: str, common_env: Dict[str, str]) -> Dict[str, str]:$/

ctags.name: map_framework_to_common
ctags.pattern: /^def map_framework_to_common(framework: str, framework_env: Dict[str, str]) -> Dict[str, str]:$/
